title: Argentinian Empanada Chickpea Fritters
description: A fusion of traditional Argentinian empanadas and crispy Middle Eastern fritters, made with chickpeas and spices.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Divide the empanada dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of mashed chickpeas in the center of each circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper over the chickpeas.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
Serve hot with a side of double fried onions and a dollop of tzatziki sauce.
